method.description: Reconstruction method: 'aqmh' (AQMH First default) or 'classic_tile_compile'. If missing, defaults to 'aqmh'.

linear_required.description: Deprecated: non-linear frames are warn-only in the runner and are no longer removed.

dark_already_bias_corrected.description: Set true only for master darks whose bias pedestal has already been removed.

mode.description: Frame normalization mode. 'background' subtracts a per-frame background estimate — DANGER for extended emission nebulae (M42, Orion, large HII regions): it subtracts real nebula signal, destroying dynamic range. Use 'median' for any target filling >10% of the frame. 'background' is only safe for point sources, small galaxies, or targets much smaller than the frame.

auto_engine.description: When true, probes a few frames before registration and overrides the engine to triangle_star_matching+affine when strong field rotation is detected (Alt/Az mount). Default: true.

auto_engine_rotation_threshold_deg.description: Rotation per frame in degrees above which auto_engine triggers the override. Default: 0.05 (triggers at ~0.6 deg/min for 5s exposures, well above EQ residual <0.01 deg/frame).

max_blind_chain_depth.description: Maximum blind-chain rescue depth. 0 = auto (N/10, clamped 12-50). >0 = manual override. Default: 0.

blind_chain_strong_anchor_cc.description: CC threshold for strong anchors in blind chains. Frames above this CC can start deeper chains. Default: 0.08.

blind_chain_drift_threshold_px.description: Max allowed drift per frame in a blind chain (px). Default: 2.0.

use_astrometry.description: Enable astrometric rescue via ASTAP for frames that fail all other methods. Requires astap_bin and astap_data_dir. Default: true.

enable_local_background_subtraction.description: Run local background subtraction before star detection. Helps with moonlight or strong gradients. Default: false.

star_shift_radius_px.description: Search radius for the shift-consistency filter in triangle_star_matching (px on proxy image). Must cover the maximum expected inter-frame shift. Equatorial: 60, Alt/Az (e.g. DWARF II): 200-400. Default: 200. WARNING: if set too small, frames with shifts exceeding this radius will silently fail registration (cc≈0, chain_depth=0). Never reduce below the measured maximum per-frame shift.

weight_exponent_scale.description: Exponent scale k for G_f = exp(k * Q_f). k=1.0 (default) is standard, k>1 increases differentiation between good/bad frames. E.g. k=1.5 gives typical ratio ~20:1, k=2.0 gives ~54:1. CRITICAL SIDE EFFECT ON REGISTRATION: This value also controls the quality-based anchor frame selection for registration. Higher k concentrates weight on fewer high-quality frames, causing anchor frames to cluster in high-quality regions and leaving the rest of the sequence without nearby anchors — causing chain_depth=0 registration failures. HARD RULES: (1) frame_count > 300: maximum allowed is 1.2. Do NOT recommend values above 1.2 regardless of quality spread. (2) frame_count 100-300: maximum 1.5 only if FWHM p90/p10 ratio > 1.5 (>50% spread). (3) Only frame_count < 100 with extreme spread may use k=2.0. Example: 610 frames → max k=1.2 even with high quality spread. Recommending k=2.0 for >300 frames is WRONG and causes registration failures.

k_local.description: Exponent scale for local weight L_{f,t}=exp(k_local*Q_local). Default 1.0; >1 increases local differentiation between tiles, <1 softens it. NOTE: unlike weight_exponent_scale, k_local does NOT affect registration anchor selection. Safe to tune independently. High values (>2.0) can cause tile boundary artifacts if local quality varies sharply.

aqmh.description: AQMH-specific configuration. The 'enabled' flag is derived from the top-level 'method' field and should not be set manually.

enabled.description: Runtime flag derived from Config.method. true when method='aqmh', false when method='classic_tile_compile'.

resolution_divisor.description: Downsamples stored AQMH quality maps. 1 keeps full resolution, 2 stores half width/height (~1/4 pixels), 4 stores quarter width/height. RULE: if recommending cherry_pick.enabled=true in the same analysis, you MUST recommend resolution_divisor=1. Recommending cherry_pick.enabled=true AND resolution_divisor=2 together is contradictory — downsampled quality maps negate per-pixel cherry_pick accuracy.

dtype.description: Storage data type for AQMH quality maps. float32 is exact; uint16 is recommended for lower disk and I/O cost; uint8 is smallest but coarser.

max_resident_maps.description: Maximum number of full-resolution AQMH quality maps kept in RAM by the reconstruction read cache. 0 disables the read cache.

enabled.description: Enables per-pixel best-k frame selection during reconstruction. The pipeline also enforces an internal quality gate: if cherry_pick increases background_rms by more than max_background_rms_increase_percent, it is automatically disabled regardless of this flag. Only recommend enabling when the frame set has a significant quality spread (FWHM p90/p10 ratio > 1.3 or >20% spread) AND k_frac is set conservatively (<=0.6). Do NOT recommend enabling for large homogeneous frame sets where quality spread is low — it increases per-pixel tile inconsistency and raises background_rms.

k_frac.description: Fraction of total frames retained per pixel tile. COMMON MISTAKE: reasoning 'if ~10% of frames are bad, use k_frac=0.90 to discard 10%' is WRONG for large frame counts — each tile independently selects its best k frames from a spatially varying quality map, so different tiles use different frame subsets, creating per-tile flux baseline shifts that raise background_rms and produce tile-pattern artifacts. The pipeline quality gate will auto-disable cherry_pick if background_rms rises. HARD RULES: (1) frame_count > 300: maximum k_frac = 0.5. The argument 'k_frac=0.3 wastes good frames' does NOT override this — k_frac=0.3-0.5 with 610 frames still retains 183-305 frames per tile, far above stacking minimum. (2) frame_count 100-300: max k_frac = 0.7. (3) frame_count < 100: up to 0.9. Correct example: 610 frames, 10% bad -> k_frac=0.45. Do NOT use k_frac >= 0.85 for any dataset with >300 frames.

enabled.description: Legacy compatibility flag. Prefer bge.method. If bge.method is present it is authoritative; otherwise enabled=true maps to method=classic and enabled=false maps to method=none.

method.description: BGE engine selector. none disables BGE; classic uses the existing grid/tile BGE; autobge uses the two-stage poly+RBF AutoBGE engine. This field is authoritative when present.

num_sample_points.description: Number of AutoBGE sample points. 0 lets the implementation derive a deterministic image-size-based count.

patch_size.description: Odd patch size used for local background sampling.

stretch_mode.description: Working-space transform used only for AutoBGE sampling/fitting. Default linear preserves the additive background contract; mtf is an experimental AutoBGE-parity mode.

apply_guards.description: When true, AutoBGE uses the shared outer BGE apply guards before mutating RGB output.

tile_weight_lambda_structure.description: Lambda in tile reliability weight w_t=exp(-lambda*structure_score_t)*(1-masked_fraction_t). Default 1.0.

sample_estimator.description: Tile background sample estimator. quantile uses bge.sample_quantile; sigma_clipped_median, sextractor_mode and biweight use robust tile-pixel estimators.

min_sample_bg_value.description: Minimum tile background sample value accepted for BGE aggregation.

mag_limit.description: Magnitude limit for PCC catalog star matching. CAUTION: for small sensors or short exposures (consumer OSC cameras, DWARF II, Seestar), mag_limit > 15 includes stars below the detection threshold, causing phantom matches against background noise. Keep <= 14-15 for consumer cameras. Only increase to 16-18 for large-aperture deep exposures.

common_overlap_required_fraction.description: Required pixel fraction across all usable frames for COMMON_OVERLAP. Default 1.0 = strict intersection.

tile_common_valid_min_fraction.description: Minimum COMMON_OVERLAP coverage per tile. Default 1.0 = only tiles fully inside the support mask are considered valid.

kappa_cluster.description: Quality-weight exponent for synthetic-cluster aggregation: w_k = exp(kappa_cluster * Q_k).

cap_ratio.description: Optional dominance cap ratio for cluster weights: w_k <= cap_ratio * median_j(w_j).

acceleration_backend.description: Beschleunigungs-Backend fuer PREWARP/TILE_RECONSTRUCTION/STACKING. 'auto' (Standard) erkennt automatisch verfuegbare GPU-Backends (CUDA/OpenCL) zur Laufzeit. Prioritaet: CUDA -> OpenCL -> CPU. 'opencv_cuda' erzwingt NVIDIA CUDA, 'opencv_opencl'/'opencl' erzwingt OpenCL (AMD/Intel/NVIDIA), 'cpu' deaktiviert GPU. Faellt sauber auf CPU zurueck wenn Hardware nicht verfuegbar.
